lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's transformed?! I didn't expect her to pull out a trump card like that.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Damn it! She's using Rapunzel's and Noah's tech as well!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: A clumsy imitation, nothing more! Keep moving!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: By Mother's grace!
Altruia's body is bathed in gold.
At the same time, a green, glowing shield unfolds.
The shield continues to expand, reaching an overwhelming size.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What is that...?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's trying to push us back! Commander! Get back!
The shield bears down on us like a massive wall, trying to force us back.
Snow White aims all her weapons forward.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Do not retreat!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We'll just pierce our way through!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, you're right!
*Vrrrrrr!*
A thunderous roar emanates from Seven Dwarves.
Can we pierce through? That shield's clearly imitating Noah's...
If we can't pierce it, it'll push us back, and we'll be burned alive.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: D-damn it!
I glance at Anis who is clearly restless.
The shield's particles close in on her.
Anis! The expansive armament!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Wh-what...?
That shield's no different from a thin beam!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: A-all right! I'll try!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Uh... I think it's... something like this?
She stares at her fingertips.
Sweat pours down her furrowed brow.
It seems whatever she's trying isn't going as intended.
At that moment, the shield starts to disintegrate, flowing effortlessly into her hand.
The shield dissipates, and radiant light gathers in Anis's hand.
Anis! Entertainment Punch!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Hiiii-yyyyyaaaaaah!
*Boom!*
With a deafening roar, a blinding flash erupts.
The light she gathered explodes before she can fire it.
Anis is thrown back, and the shockwave sweeps across the area.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Now!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Pierce through!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ahh...
Snow White and Rapi's assault tears through Altruia.
Altruia stares in disbelief at the massive hole blown straight through her body.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: No... Noooooo!
*Crack!*
Golden light bursts from within Altruia,
and the wound heals instantly.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: You dare wound the body bestowed upon me by Mother?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Looks like your mommy didn't give you a proper body.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You probably shouldn't keep provoking her...

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Forgive me, Mother.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Your foolish daughter shall go and beg for your forgiveness.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Please, deliver unto me a punishment without mercy.
Altruia soars into the sky,
leaving a golden trail as she disappears beyond the horizon.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: A new Heretic...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The Queen... I thought she had been dormant all this time, yet she was manufacturing a new creation.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I-I'm sorry. I screwed up at the most crucial moment.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I tried to blast her away, but it didn't work.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: What are you talking about? The shield was neutralized.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I wouldn't call that a mistake.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's targeting the Ark.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I understand Johan and Cecil.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I understand their desire to kill the Queen without relying on the Ark.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I even thought they could do it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: But not anymore.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: That Heretic didn't suffer so much as a scratch during our battle.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: She carries Noah's defenses and Rapunzel's regenerative abilities.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: And there's no chance she's the only one.
Which means...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You must find a way, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: A way to use the Ark's power, without trampling on Johan and Cecil's pride.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Please.
That was the plan all along.
Eden is strong. No one disputes that.
But we're going up against the Queen who stole Liliweiss's body.
She could build new Heretics and entirely new Rapture factions.
We need to avail ourselves of every option available to us.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Good. I'll leave that to you then.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Return to the Ark at once. I'll head to Eden immediately.
Okay. We'll see each other again soon.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: That we will.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... I'm sorry about Marian.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You trusted us, and we failed to protect her.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I am sorry.
Marian isn't dead yet.
Don't blame yourselves. You all did everything you could.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: All right...
Snow White turns and sprints back the way we came.
We watch her briefly, then resume our path toward the Ark.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, what's your plan?
First, we secure the Nikke production technology. Then we report everything.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We might end up at odds with Eden.
We'll need to approach this with some thought,
and I'm sure Deputy Chief Andersen and Enikk will come up with something appropriate.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes. I agree.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Should we send support to Eden? They seem very vulnerable, even with Snow White there.
I'll contact the Four Beasts
and ask them to come to Eden.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, that's a good idea. Eden's defensive capabilities have taken a major hit.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Whether Eden accepts them is uncertain, but maybe making it clear that you're their ally might make a difference.
Yeah. The Queen tore out Marian's core.
There's no guarantee she won't go after our ch... err, the child.
It would be for the best if Eden and the Four Beasts stayed together.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I hope the Queen doesn't move too quickly.
We'll have to trust Liberalio.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She said she would try to persuade the Queen.
Right. It would be ideal if everything goes well. However, if it doesn't, it'll still buy us some time.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Understood. Sounds like we'll be busy.
We walk quickly.
Liberalio walks ahead,
her footsteps the only sound in the otherwise still air.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It's so quiet...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: What a nice place.
Liberalio keeps walking,
then stops.
The Queen, adopting Liliweiss's form,
looks down at Liberalio with a faint smile.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Ohh... Mother...
Liberalio approaches.
She stops in front of the Queen.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You've come.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I've missed you so, so much.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I wanted to see you sooner, but I was delayed.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'm sorry, Mother.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I did my best, truly.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Please forgive me.
The Queen looks at Liberalio with the same unchanging smile.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Mother...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I tried to make the surface as clean as possible for the day you would return, but I couldn't do it.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Still, hear me out, I beg of you.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We can talk to them.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We may be different by birth and species, but we can still have a conversation with them.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We can come to an understanding.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I witnessed that miracle with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It was so beautiful. It awakened in me a feeling of love.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: So Mother...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Would you speak with them, just once?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: There's no need for pain. No need for hate.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Through dialogue, I believe we can understand and change one another.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Then one day... we will all be able to dream...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: of peace.
The Queen looks at Liberalio with the same unchanging smile.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Please, Mother.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Please speak with them.
The Queen approaches Liberalio.
She reaches out with both hands and gently cups Liberalio's cheeks.
Liberalio closes her eyes and leans into the touch.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Oh... Mother...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I've dreamed of this day... for so long.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I love you, Mother.
*Crack*
Liberalio's head is torn off.
The Queen smiles, staring into Liberalio's eyes, now frozen in shock.
Liberalio's mouth opens and closes soundlessly.
The smile on the Queen's face remains.
Liberalio's eyes dim, little by little,
until all light fades.
The Queen tosses the head aside without a thought,
then walks toward the headless body.
Raptures appear from nowhere and carry it away.
The Queen returns to her original place, gazing into space with that same smile.
Watching her, Mirror is certain.
The Queen is beyond reason,
a monster in every possible sense.
